confidence_notes: Restaurant and hostel anchors rest on a few Kyoto-specific or Japan-wide sources that conflict and have unclear dates, so they are bounded estimates for July 2026. Hotel anchors are the least certain: the 3-star figure is a judgement from citywide averages in several currencies, and the 1-star figure is an inferred basic-business-hotel rate. Cocktail and wine_glass are derived from the local beer relationship because direct Kyoto data was weak. The FX value 0.6947 for 2026-10-16 was taken from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA table; I did not open the RBA page to confirm it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable foreign city was used. Anchors are based on Kyoto-specific comparison-site prices, Japan-wide draft beer and cappuccino ranges, Kyoto hostel averages from Hostelz and BudgetYourTrip, and Kyoto citywide hotel averages from Cheapflights and HotelsCombined. Nearby Japanese cities (Shizuoka, Kofu, Kitakyushu) were used only as a cross-check on cafe prices.
